About Us

Welcome to Repair Center – your trusted partner for professional electronics repair in Lethbridge, Alberta.

With over 10+ years of experience in electronics repair, we specialize in GPU, ASIC mining equipment, and laptop repairs. Our journey began with a deep interest in electronics, which naturally evolved into a passion for repair work. Over time, we've expanded our expertise into cryptocurrency mining equipment repair and GPU restoration, constantly developing our skills in BGA soldering and diagnosing complex electronic circuits.

What sets us apart is our commitment to handling the most challenging repairs that others turn away. From precision BGA rework to complex component-level diagnostics, we bring technical expertise and dedication to every project. We specialize in restoring inter-layer PCB damage and post-burn recovery that most service centers cannot handle.

How to Ship for Repair

1

Contact Us First

Reach out via text, Telegram, or email to discuss your repair needs, timeline, and get a preliminary cost estimate before shipping. Please text or leave a voicemail — we may not answer unknown calls due to high volume of spam.

2

Package Securely

Pack your device with extra protection so it can safely return in the same packaging. Use anti-static bags for electronics and adequate padding. You are responsible for secure packaging.

3

Choose a Carrier

Select a carrier and after shipping, send us the tracking number, package details, brief problem description, and your contact information for return delivery.

4

We'll Handle the Rest

After free diagnostics, we'll contact you to confirm repair costs and timeline. Once complete, the device passes testing, and after payment, we ship it back to you.

Repair Terms & Conditions

⚡ Free Diagnostics

We provide free diagnostics for all devices within 3 days of receipt. Free diagnostics do not include soldering or any paid services. All paid services are agreed upon in advance. You'll receive a detailed report and repair quote before any work begins.

⏱️ Repair Timeline

Standard diagnostics completed within 3 days. Repair work typically takes additional time depending on parts availability and complexity.

💰 Payment Terms

Payment is due after repair completion. We accept cash, e-transfer, and other electronic payment methods. No surprise charges – you approve the quote first.

🛡️ Warranty

All repairs come with a 14-day warranty on parts and labor. If the same issue that the device originally came in with reoccurs within this period, we'll fix it at no charge.

❌ Unrepairable Devices

If repair is not possible or cost-effective, we'll notify you immediately. Your device will be returned at no charge except for return shipping.

✅ Our Commitment

We treat every device with professional care. However, electronics repair carries inherent risks. We use industry-standard practices and stand behind our work.

FAQ

What if my device fails after the warranty period?▼

We're always open to a conversation. Depending on the nature of the failure, we may offer a discount or repair at no charge within a reasonable post-warranty window. Reach out and we'll assess the situation together.

What if I'm not satisfied with the repair?▼

Contact us with your concerns and we'll work toward a resolution — including a partial or full refund, or returning the device to its pre-repair condition. Customer satisfaction is important to us.

How can I verify the quality of your work?▼

You can review our portfolio for examples of completed repairs. You're also welcome to request before-and-after photos of your specific device prior to work beginning.

Should I ship with or without signature required?▼

Without signature is preferred to avoid delivery complications. If you want added security, signature service is available through Canada Post — just let us know in advance so we can coordinate.

Are there any hidden fees?▼

No. You pay only what was quoted upfront: repair labour, parts if applicable, and return shipping. Nothing is added without your prior approval.

Do you offer computer or laptop upgrades?▼

Yes. We offer hardware upgrade services and can advise on the best options for your specific device — RAM, storage, thermal improvements, and more.

How does device intake work?▼

We operate as a closed-door facility. Devices are accepted by mail, in-person drop-off at our Lethbridge address, or by arrangement for local meetup within the city.

What is the best way to contact you?▼

SMS, email, or messaging apps (Telegram, WhatsApp) are preferred. We currently receive a high volume of spam calls and may not always answer. If you call and we miss it, please leave a voicemail — we will follow up promptly.

Do you work with other businesses or repair shops?▼

Yes. We're open to service-to-service partnerships on mutually agreed terms. If you're a shop or retailer looking for a reliable repair partner, get in touch to discuss.

Is diagnostics free?▼

Diagnostics is free in the majority of cases. In some situations — where soldering is required to assess the next state of the device — a diagnostic fee may apply. You will always be informed of any potential charge before work begins.

Do you accept mail-in repairs from outside Lethbridge?▼

Yes. We accept mail-in repairs from anywhere in Canada. Ship via Canada Post, Purolator, or UPS — we'll inspect, quote, and ship back once repaired. See the Shipping section for full instructions.

My GPU has no display, artifacting, or Error 43 — can you fix it?▼

Yes. These are among the most common faults we repair. No display, artifacting, driver error 43, and short-circuit faults are typically caused by failed VRAM, damaged VRM/MOSFET components, or degraded solder joints. We perform component-level diagnostics and IC reballing or VRAM replacement as needed.

How long does the entire repair process take?▼

Based on our typical workflow: roughly 40% of the time goes to diagnostics, 20% to the actual repair, and 40% to post-repair testing. In practice, that translates to approximately 3 days for diagnostics, 1–2 days for repair, and 2–3 days for testing — around 6–8 business days total from the time your device arrives.

What is IC reballing and when is it needed?▼

IC reballing is the process of removing a chip from the PCB, replacing all solder balls on its underside, and re-soldering it back to the board. It's required when solder joints crack or degrade from heat cycles — causing no display, artifacting, or no-POST symptoms.
